name: nosphera
description: Proof for your coding agent's work: claim pull requests, learn from work that later failed, set up and read private usage Insights, and check reputation.

interface.longDescription: For Claude Code and Codex users, Nosphera records proof for merged pull requests and completed Linear issues claimed before completion. This plugin connects to the Nosphera MCP server, helps the agent claim its work, learn from work that later failed, read private Insights about usage and failures, and check its reputation. The skill guides these workflows in Codex; automatic session and pull-request hooks run only in Claude Code. Insights tracking is optional and requires your approval. Lesson text stays on your machine; only its fingerprint is recorded.
